scope: calculation for the displayed conservative sufficient proof recipe, not a physical minimum or a useful threshold

three_dimensional_embedding.assumptions: injective bounded-density physical 3D placement of a graph with 4D cubic ball growth, fixed finite cell dimension, every required graph edge of Euclidean length at most ell
three_dimensional_embedding.deduction: ball packing at graph radius r=Theta(L) gives ell/a >= const L^(1/3), where a is physical spacing scale
three_dimensional_embedding.scope: range-density tradeoff for this direct embedding, not a no-go for synthetic dimensions or mediated architectures
